subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should this PR's persisted announceLastRun lifecycle marker, killed-state reconciliation for interrupted announce turns, and tool-free announce semantics be accepted for this Telegram/subagent recovery fix once hosted lint is green?
rationale: The patch appears correct, but it deliberately changes persisted session lifecycle behavior and a security-sensitive Codex/native tool boundary, which are maintainer-owned merge-risk decisions rather than contributor-only follow-up.

options.title: Accept and merge after green lint
options.body: Rerun or clear the hosted check-lint failure, then land the PR with explicit acceptance of the announce session-state and tool-boundary behavior.

options.title: Ask for narrower recovery semantics
options.body: Require a maintainer-specified alternative to killed-state reconciliation if the current persisted-state outcome is not the desired user-visible recovery state.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Keep the PR open or close it only if maintainers decide announce turns should remain normal recoverable human turns despite the proven Telegram cascade.

recommendation.title: Accept and merge after green lint
recommendation.body: Rerun or clear the hosted check-lint failure, then land the PR with explicit acceptance of the announce session-state and tool-boundary behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The history points to steipete as a recent maintainer of both session lifecycle state and Codex app-server behavior, which are the two merge-risk surfaces.
